title: W10785366A — Laundry Service Diagnostic entry
description: Smart washer/dryer 3-button × 3 Service Diagnostic entry within 8 seconds.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Connected Smart Appliances — Third Generation (Job Aid W10785366A)

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Standby (plugged in, indicators off). Pick any 3 buttons except POWER. Within 8 seconds press/release 1st, 2nd, 3rd — repeat that same sequence two more times (3 rounds). Success: all indicators on 5 sec with 888 on display and a tone.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press and Release the 1st, 2nd, 3rd selected button; Repeat 2 more times.
